source.repository: Library Checker problem set and MathWorld
source.algorithm: Legendre prime-counting formula and partial-sieve function
source.reuse: The operation contract and mathematical formula are used as references; all implementations and oracles are independently written. No source code or prose is copied.

contract.operation: Return pi(x), the number of primes less than or equal to x.
contract.algorithm: Legendre formula pi(x)=phi(x,pi(sqrt(x)))+pi(sqrt(x))-1; evaluate phi by recursive inclusion-exclusion over the first pi(sqrt(x)) primes.
contract.oracle: Direct Sieve of Eratosthenes through x, independent of the Legendre formula.
